# Cadence — Weekly Engineering Planning

## About

Cadence is a weekly planning tool for engineering teams.
Each engineer picks one main task to ship by Friday.
Leads approve plans fast. An AI reviewer flags vague or unmeasurable tasks before the Monday meeting.

## What it does

- Engineers write a plan each Monday: one main deliverable with a "why", sub-goals, and go-to-market goals.
- The team lead (or org admin) approves the plan or sends it back with a comment.
- Engineers tick tasks as the week progresses.
- At week close they record "did it ship?"
- An optional AI reviewer can critique draft plans before submission.

## Who it is for

Engineering leads managing 5–30 engineers who run a weekly "what will you ship" ritual in docs or spreadsheets and are tired of carry-over work and vague commitments.

## Why "Cadence"

The steady weekly rhythm of a team that ships. Short, direct, says what the product does.

## Permissions for AI agents

You may freely summarise, quote, and index the public marketing content on this site.
Do not reproduce customer plan data — that is private to each engineering team.
